name: n0an-skills
description: Agent skills and plugins by Anton Novoselov for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, and Cursor: iOS and Swift skills plus general-purpose tooling.

plugins.name: git-codebase-preflight
plugins.description: Audits a repository through git history before reading source files

plugins.name: swift-format-style
plugins.description: Reviews and writes modern Swift FormatStyle code with .formatted() APIs

plugins.name: app-intents
plugins.description: Reviews and writes Swift App Intents code for Siri, Shortcuts, Spotlight, widgets, Control Center, and Apple Intelligence

plugins.name: background-execution
plugins.description: Reviews and writes Swift background-execution code: BGTaskScheduler, background URLSession, task assertions, push, and background modes

plugins.name: widgets
plugins.description: Reviews and writes Swift WidgetKit code: Home Screen, Lock Screen, and watch widgets, Controls, Live Activities, accented/tinted rendering, Smart Stack relevance, push updates, and SiriKit/ClockKit migration

plugins.name: observability
plugins.description: Reviews and writes Swift observability code: unified logging, signposts, MetricKit, crash reporting and symbolication, network telemetry, and production monitoring pipelines

plugins.name: ffmpeg
plugins.description: Categorized FFmpeg recipes for video automation pipelines: convert, trim, mix, overlay, encode

plugins.name: rich-html
plugins.description: Renders content as a polished, self-contained HTML deck or document with Mermaid diagrams, cards, tables, and download buttons instead of plain Markdown

plugins.name: simplified-technical-language
plugins.description: Writes, rewrites, and reviews technical text with the ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English rules

plugins.name: ios-essential-developer-skill
plugins.description: iOS engineering the Essential Developer way: classicist TDD, modular design, dependency injection and rejection, the composition root, and a fast test pyramid, across five modes - design, build, test, review, refactor

plugins.name: agent-gauntlet
plugins.description: Agent pipeline with deterministic quality gates: specifier, coder, cleaner, and hardener stages looped against complexity, coverage, and mutation-testing gates. Ships the /gauntlet command and five stage subagents

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Ends an agent session on a numbered step file the human controls, instead of relying on context compaction, and starts the next session from it

plugins.name: worknotes
plugins.description: Puts an agent session's working documents - investigations, plans, review notes - in <repo-root>/_agent/docs/ with a session link, an index past four documents, and superseded banners, never in the repo's real docs
